liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): A brief Main Ten jam appears just past the ten-minute mark; The second ever Main Ten jam occurs during a decent performance [4][10]
- **It's A Sin** (1 review): Pigpen rocks and his harmonica is really good in this song [14]
- **Hard To Handle** (1 review): The performance features notable slide guitar work and Pigpen vocals [5]

## The recordings

- **gd69-04-11.sbd.cotsman.15404.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 7 songs; 72 min; rated 3/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: The reviewer describes the overall recording quality as not the best; Audio is hissy from Dark Star through the Saint Stephen cut [4][5]
- **gd1969-04-11.sbd.barbella.8190.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 7 songs; 74 min; rated 2.78/5 by 9 [2]. Said about its sound: Dark Star and Saint Stephen have low recording levels until The Eleven; The recording is too quiet and features some chaotic drumming; User equalized Dark Star and Saint Stephen channels to fix volume issues [2][6][14][15]
- **gd1969-04-11.152766.sbd.bear.latavala.gems.flac16**: soundboard; 7 songs; 71 min [3]

## Around the show

- The beginning of the first set is missing from the recording [1]
- This was the band's first performance in Arizona and only in Tucson [3]
- Jim Blackwood and Jamie Waddell hosted the 2021 radio broadcast [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-04-11.sbd.cotsman.15404.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by S. Barbella, P. Braverman, A. Schlissel & J. Cotsman; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Sound Forge was used for normalization and pitch correction on the transfer [1]
- **gd1969-04-11.sbd.barbella.8190.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Steve Barbella; source: Master Soundboard Cassette > cass > dat > cd [2]
- **gd1969-04-11.152766.sbd.bear.latavala.gems.flac16**: taped by Bear; transferred by Mastered by  Jim Blackwood + Jamie Waddell. Pitch correction by Jason Chastain; source: Recording Info- Bear's SBD cassette > DAT -transferred by Dick Latvala for KXCI's Dead Air program - originally broadcast on Sept 27, 1997 [3]
